property.name: Driver Version
property.description: Version of this driver

property.name: Controller OS
property.description: Control4 OS version of this controller

property.name: Log Level
property.description: Logging level

property.name: Log Mode
property.description: Where log output goes. Turns itself off after 3 hours.

property.name: Log Messages
property.description: Print every received MQTT message (needs Log Mode Print)

property.name: Listen Port
property.description: TCP port for MQTT clients. 1883 is used by the controller's own broker.

property.name: Max Clients
property.description: Refuse new connections above this many

property.name: Server Status
property.description: Whether the port is open

property.name: Test Summary
property.description: Clients, problems and worst timer lag at a glance

property.name: Connected Clients
property.description: Clients that completed the MQTT handshake

property.name: Open Connections
property.description: Open TCP connections, including ones still handshaking

property.name: Peak Connections
property.description: Most connections open at the same time

property.name: Total Connections
property.description: Connections accepted since the last reset

property.name: Rejected Connections
property.description: Refused: unsupported protocol, bad client id or Max Clients

property.name: Client Takeovers
property.description: A client reconnected with the same id and replaced its old connection

property.name: Keepalive Timeouts
property.description: Clients closed for going quiet longer than 1.5 x keepalive

property.name: Slow Clients Dropped
property.description: Clients closed because 1 MB of output was waiting for them

property.name: Messages In
property.description: PUBLISH packets received

property.name: Messages Delivered
property.description: Messages sent on to subscribers

property.name: Messages per Second
property.description: Messages received per second, last 5 seconds

property.name: Retained Messages
property.description: Retained messages held in memory

property.name: Wills Published
property.description: Last Will messages sent for clients that dropped

property.name: Data In
property.description: Bytes and packets received

property.name: Data Out
property.description: Bytes and packets sent

property.name: TCP Reads
property.description: Socket reads; split and multi-packet counts show framing works

property.name: Protocol Errors
property.description: Malformed or unexpected MQTT data. Should stay 0.

property.name: Last Protocol Error
property.description: Most recent protocol error

property.name: Socket Errors
property.description: Socket-level errors

property.name: Last Socket Error
property.description: Most recent socket error

property.name: Driver Errors
property.description: Lua errors inside this driver. Should stay 0.

property.name: Last Driver Error
property.description: Most recent Lua error

property.name: Timer Lag
property.description: How late the 1-second timer fires: a measure of how busy Director is

property.name: Lua Memory
property.description: Memory used by this driver's Lua state

property.name: Running For
property.description: Time since start or the last statistics reset
